abstract: Covers XML Schema. W3C XML Schema Definition Language (XSD) 1.1 Part 1: Structures is current; XML Schema Part 1: Structures Second Edition is legacy; W3C XML Schema Definition Language (XSD) 1.1 Part 2: Datatypes is current; XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition is legacy. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
